day_shape: US fighter jets struck an IRGC missile-launch site on Qeshm after IRGC drones were intercepted over Bahrain, IRGC reports a third smuggling vessel hitting a mine in Hormuz, UK sanctions eight West Bank settlement firms, and CNN reports US intel on an alleged Iranian 'dirty bomb' plot against Trump officials.

threads.label: Qeshm strike and Bahrain drone exchange
threads.summary: US fighter jets struck an IRGC missile launch site on Qeshm Island, which CENTCOM and Jerusalem Post said followed intercepted IRGC one-way attack drones launched toward Bahrain's Sheikh Isa Air Base. IRIB confirmed an enemy attack on the outskirts of a Qeshm city with no infrastructure damage, while CENTCOM called the IRGC's radar-hit claim false.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz smuggling vessel explosions
threads.summary: The IRGC Navy's public relations arm said a third smuggling vessel transiting the Strait of Hormuz exploded at 21:45 after striking a naval mine near Ghanaim island, as reported by IRIB and Defa Press. CENTCOM posted that USS Theodore Roosevelt and USS George Washington were sailing together in the Arabian Sea on 17 November.

threads.label: Khamenei orders unlimited response, IRGC rhetoric
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and Defa Press published an order from the supreme commander to armed forces commanders for an "immediate, effective and geographically unlimited response" to any potential enemy threat. Defa Press and IRIB also carried IRGC spokesman Mohebby's jibe that the CENTCOM commander deserves a "damage medal".

threads.label: Alleged Iranian plots against US and Israeli targets
threads.summary: CNN, cited by Times of Israel, reported US intelligence suggesting Iran is working on plans to target senior Trump administration figures with a dirty bomb or chemical weapon in Washington. Iran International reported a Hezbollah/Quds Force plot using six Qom-trained Thai clerics to attack the Israeli embassy in Bangkok.

threads.label: UK and EU sanctions on settlements and Hamas
threads.summary: The FCDO announced sanctions on eight Israeli companies building West Bank settlements and the Tzav 9 group blocking Gaza aid, as reported by Jerusalem Post. The EU separately sanctioned the 'Gaza Now' outlet and its founder over financial support for Hamas, while a tabled UK parliamentary question asked about sanctioning Iran-linked media.

threads.label: Pahlavi–Herzog webinar and Iran opposition
threads.summary: President Isaac Herzog voiced hope that exiled Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi would return to Iran after the Islamic Republic's fall during a joint webinar, according to Jerusalem Post. Iran International reported Pahlavi warned of a "second Holocaust" if the Islamic Republic survived to pursue nuclear weapons.

threads.label: US Navy Senate hearing on Iran war toll
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Democratic lawmakers attacked acting Navy head Hong Kao as a Trump "yes man" over the Iran war's mental-health toll on sailors, citing eight suicide attempts on an aircraft carrier. IRIB quoted Kao telling the Senate that the US Navy had used re-coded expired ammunition in the war against Iran.

events.title_en: Disruption in highly classified communications network of US National Security Agency. The internal network NSA Net used for exchange of classified information and confidential communications of National Security Agency staff has gone down. CNN reported citing six informed sources that this disruption is under investigation and National Security Agency has arranged phased entry of its staff to manage the situation. According to this report, to date no evidence has been obtained regarding cyberattack or breach of this network. CNN contacted NSA for official clarification but no response has yet been released by the agency.

events.title_en: Hezbollah Lebanon condoles death of Ayatollah Vahid Khorassani. Hezbollah in its statement considered Ayatollah Khorassani a fountain of knowledge and guidance, strong fortress of piety and spirituality, and an abundant spring overflowing with moral and human values. Lebanese resistance said that he devoted his honourable life to service of pure Muhammadan Islam, dissemination of teachings of Ahl al-Bayt, teaching jurisprudence and Islamic knowledge, protection of Islam's entity and confrontation with heresies and intellectual and moral deviations. Hezbollah emphasised that the scientific, jurisprudential and value-based legacy left by this great jurist and his efforts in nurturing generations of scholars and virtuous men will forever remain alive and steadfast in the conscience of believers and his admirers.

events.title_en: Saudi elements' scheme to smuggle weapons into Taez, Yemen foiled. Al-Masirah news network reported foiling of Saudi mercenaries' plan to smuggle weapons and ammunition into city of Taez. Yemeni Army over past 3 days through series of security operations managed to seize seven vehicles carrying weapons and ammunition. According to Al-Masirah, discovered equipment included rifles, semi-heavy weapons and quantities of alcoholic beverages. According to this report, smugglers used hideouts and special equipment inside vehicles to transport weapons and ammunition.
